functions.name: revealText
functions.signature: (text: string, options: { progress: Signal<number>; unit?: "grapheme" | "word" | undefined; locale?: string | undefined; }, context: FrameContext): string
functions.documentation: Absolute-time prefix reveal using existing Signal and Intl grapheme/word segmentation; no glyph shaping engine.

functions.name: wiggle
functions.signature: (options: { frequency: Signal<number>; amplitude: Signal<number>; seed?: number | undefined; dimensions?: number | undefined; octaves?: number | undefined; amplitudeMultiplier?: number | undefined; }, context: FrameContext): number[]
functions.documentation: EffectCraft-derived seeded offsets in amplitude units, from Stage-local seconds; pure random access, no integrated state.

functions.name: createVectorTools
functions.documentation: Canonical Graphics Contracts v1 tools; same-topology Morph and bounded native SVG trim sampling.

functions.name: createImageEffects
functions.signature: (init: PluginInit): Promise<{ glow(image: HTMLCanvasElement, options: { radius: Signal<number>; intensity: Signal<number>; threshold?: Signal<number> | undefined; }, context: FrameContext): Promise<...>; displacement(image: HTMLCanvasElement, options: { ...; }, context: FrameContext): Promise<...>; dispose(): Promise<...>; }>
functions.documentation: Wrap the existing locked P4 algorithms; bounded SDR Canvas8 only, never silently quantize a Surface v2.

functions.name: glow
functions.signature: (input: ProfessionalSurface, options: GlowOptions, context?: FrameContext | undefined): ProfessionalSurface
functions.documentation: Scene-linear bloom. Extract max(0,1-threshold/Y) of signed RGB and coverage, Gaussian, then add energy.

functions.name: blur
functions.signature: (input: ProfessionalSurface, options: BlurOptions, context?: FrameContext | undefined): ProfessionalSurface
functions.documentation: CPU reference Gaussian: radius is sigma in physical pixels; finite +/-ceil(3*sigma) normalized kernel.

functions.name: displacement
functions.signature: (input: ProfessionalSurface, options: DisplacementOptions, context?: FrameContext | undefined): ProfessionalSurface
functions.documentation: Float upgrade of the existing deterministic sine field. Physical px, absolute seconds, bilinear premultiplied sampling.

functions.name: applyFloatKernel
functions.signature: (input: ProfessionalSurface, options: FloatEffectOptions, kernel: FloatKernel, context?: FrameContext | undefined): ProfessionalSurface
functions.documentation: Trusted authored CPU kernel extension. Shares the exact validation/color/alpha/publication path used by builtins.

functions.name: surfaceFromCoverage
functions.documentation: Coverage is geometry, not an SDR color image. RGB ink is arbitrary finite scene-linear HDR.

functions.name: createCoverageRasterizer
functions.documentation: Browser text/path coverage only. A8 supersampling does not reduce HDR RGB to Canvas8. Fonts remain browser-owned.

environment.host: Managed Web bindings; CPU float effects and explicit Legacy Canvas8

limitations: Trim: single contour, px units, polyline approximation, no offset/wrap
Morph: matching command topology and point IDs
Professional: CPU 16F/32F scene-linear; Legacy Canvas overload remains SDR; no professional GPU pass
Named Web Stage bindings v1 and declaration-only typed managed Flat are supported; JS-only graphs use capsule
